name: diagnose
title_zh: PlainTab 故障诊断员：从启动到壁纸逐层排查
tagline_zh: 装它，是因为你不想再对着控制台瞎猜。它按启动、存储、壁纸、扩展流逐层定位，连性能回退都给你圈出可疑提交。
tagline_en: Stop guessing at the console. It walks startup, storage, wallpaper, extension flows, and perf regressions layer.
desc_en: Use when diagnosing PlainTab bugs, broken UI behavior, failing extension/web-mode flows, storage or wallpaper regressions, startup issues, or performance regressions.
why_zh: 它把诊断当流程走，不是当灵感碰。每层有明确的检查点，能区分「坏了」和「变慢了」，直接指向根因而非表象。
why_en: Diagnosis as a checklist, not a vibe. It separates 'broken' from 'slow' and drives to root cause, not symptoms.
limit_zh: 只认 PlainTab 仓库内的 bug；不处理用户脚本冲突、浏览器自身故障或网络问题。产物是排查路径与结论。
limit_en: Only PlainTab repo bugs; not user-script conflicts, browser faults, or network issues. Outputs a diagnosis path, not code fixes.
title_en: PlainTab bug diagnostician: startup to wallpaper
